name: MAJOR IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE (Brescia)
title: MAJOR IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE (Brescia) Faculty of Social Science - Sociology

sections.heading: MAJOR IN CRIMINAL JUSTICE (Brescia)
lines: Completion of first-year requirements, including 1.0 from Sociology courses at the 1000 level, with a mark of at least 60% in each course.
1.0 course from: Sociology 2240E, Sociology 2270A/B and Sociology 2271A/B.
2.0 courses from: Sociology 2223A/B, Sociology 2256A/B, Sociology 2259, Sociology 2260A/B, Sociology 2267A/B.
1.0 course from: Sociology 3333F/G, Sociology 3346F/G, Sociology 3360F/G, Family Studies and Human Development 3345A/B or the former Family Studies 3345A/B.
Note: The Major in Criminal Justice cannot be combined with the Major in Criminology.
Prior to May 1, 2024, this module was offered by Brescia University College.
